lines.text: It had been a long day by the water.
lines.spoken: It had been a long day by the water.

lines.text: All afternoon Jesus had been teaching from a boat, because the crowd on the shore was so thick.
lines.spoken: All afternoon Jesus had been teaching from a boat, because the crowd on the shore was so thick.
lines.hero: a boat, a crowd on the shore

lines.text: He had told them about seed and soil, about lamps and measures.
lines.spoken: He had told them about seed and soil, about lamps and measures.

lines.text: About a mustard seed that starts smaller than everything, and ends up taller than a man.
lines.spoken: About a mustard seed that starts smaller than everything, and ends up taller than a man.
lines.hero: a small seed, then a tree

lines.text: By evening He was tired.
lines.spoken: By evening He was tired.

lines.text: On that day, when evening had come, he said to them, let us go over to the other side.
lines.spoken: On that day, when evening had come, he said to them, let us go over to the other side.

lines.text: That is all He said. Not a warning. Not a forecast. Just, let us go over to the other side.
lines.spoken: That is all He said. Not a warning. Not a forecast. Just, let us go over to the other side.

lines.text: And they went. They left the crowd standing on the shore.
lines.spoken: And they went. They left the crowd standing on the shore.

lines.text: They took Him into the boat exactly as He was. Still dusty. Still with the day in His shoulders.
lines.spoken: They took Him into the boat exactly as He was. Still dusty. Still with the day in His shoulders.

lines.text: And Mark adds a small detail that matters later. Other small boats were with them.
lines.spoken: And Mark adds a small detail that matters later. Other small boats were with them.

lines.text: They were not alone out there. This was not a private crossing. There were witnesses.
lines.spoken: They were not alone out there. This was not a private crossing. There were witnesses.

lines.text: Several of these men had fished this water their whole lives.
lines.spoken: Several of these men had fished this water their whole lives.

lines.text: They knew the Sea of Galilee. They knew how fast it could turn.
lines.spoken: They knew the Sea of Galilee. They knew how fast it could turn.

lines.text: They were not afraid of boats.
lines.spoken: They were not afraid of boats.

lines.text: It came up fast, the way it does on that lake.
lines.spoken: It came up fast, the way it does on that lake.

lines.text: A big wind storm arose, and the waves beat into the boat, so much that the boat was already filled.
lines.spoken: A big wind storm arose, and the waves beat into the boat, so much that the boat was already filled.

lines.text: Matthew says the boat was covered with the waves.
lines.spoken: Matthew says the boat was covered with the waves.

lines.text: The wind first. A sound like a wall.
lines.spoken: The wind first. A sound like a wall.

lines.text: Then the water. Not spray. Weight.
lines.spoken: Then the water. Not spray. Weight.

lines.text: Waves breaking over the side and into the hull, and the men bailing with whatever their hands found.
lines.spoken: Waves breaking over the side and into the hull, and the men bailing with whatever their hands found.

lines.text: And the bailing not keeping up.
lines.spoken: And the bailing not keeping up.

lines.text: These were fishermen.
lines.spoken: These were fishermen.

lines.text: And they were losing.
lines.spoken: And they were losing.
lines.hero: the boat, low in the water

lines.text: And in the middle of it, Mark records something that has troubled readers for two thousand years.
lines.spoken: And in the middle of it, Mark records something that has troubled readers for two thousand years.

lines.text: He himself was in the stern, asleep on the cushion.
lines.spoken: He himself was in the stern, asleep on the cushion.

lines.text: Asleep.
lines.spoken: Asleep.
lines.hero: a sleeping figure, the storm around

lines.text: Not praying. Not bracing. Not calming the sea before it got bad.
lines.spoken: Not praying. Not bracing. Not calming the sea before it got bad.

lines.text: Asleep, on a cushion, in the back of a boat that was filling with water.
lines.spoken: Asleep, on a cushion, in the back of a boat that was filling with water.

lines.text: They woke him up.
lines.spoken: They woke him up.

lines.text: And they said, teacher, do you not care that we are dying.
lines.spoken: And they said, teacher, do you not care that we are dying.

lines.text: Do you not care.
lines.spoken: Do you not care.

lines.text: Not save us. Not help. The first thing out of their mouths is not a prayer. It is a wound.
lines.spoken: Not save us. Not help. The first thing out of their mouths is not a prayer. It is a wound.

lines.text: Matthew has them say, save us, Lord, we are dying.
lines.spoken: Matthew has them say, save us, Lord, we are dying.

lines.text: Mark keeps the accusatory edge. Both are true at once.
lines.spoken: Mark keeps the accusatory edge. Both are true at once.

lines.text: When you are terrified, and someone who could help is asleep, the fear comes out as an accusation.
lines.spoken: When you are terrified, and someone who could help is asleep, the fear comes out as an accusation.

lines.text: That is what fear does when it has been left alone too long.
lines.spoken: That is what fear does when it has been left alone too long.

lines.text: And note what they did not do. They did not lose their faith.
lines.spoken: And note what they did not do. They did not lose their faith.

lines.text: They went to Jesus. Angry, and frightened, and half accusing.
lines.spoken: They went to Jesus. Angry, and frightened, and half accusing.
lines.hero: a figure moving to the stern

lines.text: But they went to Him. In a boat. In the dark. And they woke Him.
lines.spoken: But they went to Him. In a boat. In the dark. And they woke Him.

lines.text: He awoke.
lines.spoken: He awoke.

lines.text: And rebuked the wind, and said to the sea, peace, be still.
lines.spoken: And rebuked the wind, and said to the sea, peace, be still.

lines.text: Peace. Be still.
lines.spoken: Peace. Be still.

lines.text: Mark uses the same word for rebuked that he uses when Jesus silences a demon.
lines.spoken: Mark uses the same word for rebuked that he uses when Jesus silences a demon.

lines.text: He is not calming weather. He is speaking to something.
lines.spoken: He is not calming weather. He is speaking to something.

lines.text: In the Greek, peace, be still is closer to be silent. Be muzzled.
lines.spoken: In the Greek, peace, be still is closer to be silent. Be muzzled.

lines.text: The same command He gives to an unclean spirit.
lines.spoken: The same command He gives to an unclean spirit.

lines.text: He stands up in a boat, in a storm that professional sailors have already lost to, and He speaks four words.
lines.spoken: He stands up in a boat, in a storm that professional sailors have already lost to, and He speaks four words.

lines.text: And it stopped.
lines.spoken: And it stopped.

lines.text: Not gradually. Not the wind dying down over the next hour.
lines.spoken: Not gradually. Not the wind dying down over the next hour.

lines.text: The wind ceased, and there was a great calm.
lines.spoken: The wind ceased, and there was a great calm.

lines.text: Mark uses a word that means a deep, flat, unnatural stillness.
lines.spoken: Mark uses a word that means a deep, flat, unnatural stillness.

lines.text: The kind that makes men more frightened than the storm did.
lines.spoken: The kind that makes men more frightened than the storm did.

lines.text: He makes the storm a calm, so that its waves are still.
lines.spoken: He makes the storm a calm, so that its waves are still.

lines.text: The psalmist had written that about God. The men in the boat watched a man do it.
lines.spoken: The psalmist had written that about God. The men in the boat watched a man do it.
lines.typed: THEY WATCHED A MAN DO IT

lines.text: Now the sea is flat, and the storm is over, and you would expect relief.
lines.spoken: Now the sea is flat, and the storm is over, and you would expect relief.

lines.text: Instead He said to them, why are you so afraid.
lines.spoken: Instead He said to them, why are you so afraid.

lines.text: How is it that you have no faith.
lines.spoken: How is it that you have no faith.

lines.text: He does not say, why did you wake me.
lines.spoken: He does not say, why did you wake me.

lines.text: He does not say, I told you we were going to the other side.
lines.spoken: He does not say, I told you we were going to the other side.

lines.text: He asks about the fear.
lines.spoken: He asks about the fear.

lines.text: Because the fear was not really about the water.
lines.spoken: Because the fear was not really about the water.

lines.text: The water only made it visible.
lines.spoken: The water only made it visible.

lines.text: They had been in a boat with Him the entire time.
lines.spoken: They had been in a boat with Him the entire time.

lines.text: The storm did not change who was in the boat.
lines.spoken: The storm did not change who was in the boat.

lines.text: It only revealed what they actually believed about Him.
lines.spoken: It only revealed what they actually believed about Him.

lines.text: That He might sleep through their dying. That He might not care.
lines.spoken: That He might sleep through their dying. That He might not care.

lines.text: And here is the mercy in the question. He asks it after the calm.
lines.spoken: And here is the mercy in the question. He asks it after the calm.

lines.text: He does not interrogate them in the wind. He gets them safe first.
lines.spoken: He does not interrogate them in the wind. He gets them safe first.

lines.text: And then He asks them to look at their own hearts.
lines.spoken: And then He asks them to look at their own hearts.

lines.text: They were greatly afraid, and said to one another.
lines.spoken: They were greatly afraid, and said to one another.

lines.text: Who then is this, that even the wind and the sea obey him.
lines.spoken: Who then is this, that even the wind and the sea obey him.

lines.text: They went out afraid of the storm. They came back afraid of Him.
lines.spoken: They went out afraid of the storm. They came back afraid of Him.
lines.typed: AFRAID OF THE STORM. AFRAID OF HIM.

lines.text: That is the last verse of the story, and it is left open on purpose.
lines.spoken: That is the last verse of the story, and it is left open on purpose.

lines.text: Mark does not tell us the answer. He tells us the question.
lines.spoken: Mark does not tell us the answer. He tells us the question.

lines.text: And he leaves it standing at the edge of the water for every reader after them.
lines.spoken: And he leaves it standing at the edge of the water for every reader after them.

lines.text: Who then is this.
lines.spoken: Who then is this.

lines.text: Maybe that is the question you are meant to carry out of this story tonight.
lines.spoken: Maybe that is the question you are meant to carry out of this story tonight.

lines.text: Not a lesson about storms.
lines.spoken: Not a lesson about storms.

lines.text: Not a promise that your storm will end on your schedule.
lines.spoken: Not a promise that your storm will end on your schedule.

lines.text: Just this. There is a man in your boat who can say peace to the wind.
lines.spoken: Just this. There is a man in your boat who can say peace to the wind.

lines.text: Let us pray.
lines.spoken: Let us pray.

lines.text: Father, thank You that You were in the boat.
lines.spoken: Father, thank You that You were in the boat.

lines.text: You were not on the shore watching us drown.
lines.spoken: You were not on the shore watching us drown.

lines.text: You were in the stern, in the same water, in the same night.
lines.spoken: You were in the stern, in the same water, in the same night.

lines.text: Whatever we are facing tonight, You are not far off from it. You are in it with us.
lines.spoken: Whatever we are facing tonight, You are not far off from it. You are in it with us.

lines.text: Forgive us for the ways our fear has sounded like accusation.
lines.spoken: Forgive us for the ways our fear has sounded like accusation.

lines.text: Forgive us for believing that Your silence meant You did not care.
lines.spoken: Forgive us for believing that Your silence meant You did not care.
lines.typed: YOUR SILENCE DID NOT MEAN THAT

lines.text: You were not indifferent. You were at rest. Teach us the difference.
lines.spoken: You were not indifferent. You were at rest. Teach us the difference.

lines.text: Lord Jesus, You spoke to the wind and it stopped.
lines.spoken: Lord Jesus, You spoke to the wind and it stopped.

lines.text: Speak to what is rising in us tonight.
lines.spoken: Speak to what is rising in us tonight.

lines.text: Where there is noise, say peace.
lines.spoken: Where there is noise, say peace.

lines.text: Where there is chaos, say be still.
lines.spoken: Where there is chaos, say be still.

lines.text: Where there is a storm we have been bailing out for years, stand up in our boat.
lines.spoken: Where there is a storm we have been bailing out for years, stand up in our boat.

lines.text: And when the water is flat, give us the courage to answer Your question honestly.
lines.spoken: And when the water is flat, give us the courage to answer Your question honestly.

lines.text: To look at our own fear and call it what it is.
lines.spoken: To look at our own fear and call it what it is.

lines.text: And then to ask the question the disciples asked, and to keep asking it all our lives.
lines.spoken: And then to ask the question the disciples asked, and to keep asking it all our lives.

lines.text: Who then is this.
lines.spoken: Who then is this.

lines.text: We want to know You, not just Your calm.
lines.spoken: We want to know You, not just Your calm.

lines.text: In Jesus' name, amen.
lines.spoken: In Jesus' name, amen.

lines.text: In peace I will both lay myself down and sleep, for you, Yahweh alone, make me live in safety.
lines.spoken: In peace I will both lay myself down and sleep, for you, Yahweh alone, make me live in safety.

lines.text: He slept in the storm because He trusted the Father in the storm.
lines.spoken: He slept in the storm because He trusted the Father in the storm.

lines.text: Tonight, if you can, sleep.
lines.spoken: Tonight, if you can, sleep.

lines.text: He is still in the boat.
lines.spoken: He is still in the boat.

lines.text: Sit, listen, and encounter God. One story, one prayer at a time.
lines.spoken: Sit, listen, and encounter God. One story, one prayer at a time.
